name: File Explorer Plugin UI
description: UI sub-spec for the recursive file tree browser: DOM structure, tree rendering, inline editing, context menus, and drag-drop interactions.

structure.header: Root directory name uppercase, accent color, border-bottom

interactions.behavior: Toggles expansion of directory children; adds/removes from this.expanded Set
Calls onFileOpen(path); highlights file with .is-file-selected class
Opens ContextMenu with: Open, Rename, Delete, Copy Path, and optional Markdown openers
Opens ContextMenu with: New File, New Folder, Paste (if copiedPath is set)
Commits rename via fs.rename, reloads tree
Creates file/folder via fs.writeFile/fs.mkdir, reloads tree
Cancels inline edit, removes input row, restores original element display

states.name: loading
states.description: Tree shows 'Loading...' placeholder while fs.readDir resolves

states.name: empty-workspace
states.description: Shows 'No workspace' when rootPath is empty

states.name: error
states.description: Shows 'Unable to read directory' when fs.readDir returns null

states.name: renaming
states.description: Original element hidden, inline input shown for rename

states.name: creating
states.description: Inline input shown at insertion point for new file/folder
